newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan pharmaceuticals rise in morning.
newsitem.headline: Japan pharmaceuticals rise in morning.

text.p: Pharmaceutical firms rose in Thursday morning trade, setting new highs for the year, brokers said.

As of 0034 GMT, Eisai Co Ltd shares were 40 yen higher at 2,300 yen, having vaulted over a previous high for the year of 2,270 set on December 2. Tanabe Seiyaku Co Ltd rose 30 yen to 990 yen. Sankyo Co Ltd climbed 50 yen to 3,170 yen.
Brokers said that the directionless state of the market was prompting purchases in defensive stocks, or issues not influenced much by the state of the economy.
"The defensive pharmaceutical sector is becoming two-tiered," one broker said. "Investors are only interested in shares of firms which have sound earnings."
